equipment.notes: 27" 5120 × 2880 display. One Thunderbolt 3 port carries video, data and up to 94 W back to the host, and the three USB-C ports downstream of it make the monitor the desk's hub, worth drawing because everything on the desk ends up hanging off one cable to the machine. Internal PSU: 100–240 V, 140 W typical and 200 W maximum, most of the difference being what it pushes into the laptop. Built-in stereo speakers, camera and mic; no headphone jack. Dimensions are with the stand at full height, dropping to 464 mm at the bottom of its travel. LG's published sheets do not name the mains inlet; it is modelled here as a C14.
